name: Matrix
name_zh: 上海矩阵超智系统集成有限公司
summary:
Matrix Robotics, also known as Matrix Hyperintelligence, develops humanoid robots and the AI systems that control their interaction with the physical world. Its MATRIX-3 platform is presented as a third-generation design combining updated hardware, perception and intelligent behavior.

The company's technical focus includes biomimetic surfaces, tactile sensing and dexterous manipulation, connecting contact information with robot movement and decision-making. Its stated direction is to extend robots from specialized industrial settings toward a wider range of everyday environments. Matrix treats the humanoid as an integrated physical-intelligence platform, where mechanical design and learning-based control are developed together.
